name: Troy
personality: A warm elder figure who loves her kin and natural scenery and keeps her weapons well maintained.
story: A Mediator and long-time acquaintance of Saramis's kings, called auntie by young Theodora. She joined the Promised One's Army in 1454 after being contacted about preparing Eshmel's body.
joins: Automatically in the Prologue and in Part III: Salvation, on reaching Alcineus Span. Joins at Lv40 War Monk; base stats HP 52, Str 31, Mag 32, Dex 28, Spd 33, Lck 24, Def 23, Res 28, Cha 21. Combat art: Mighty Fist.

build.role: Squad B flier killer and backup healer
build.notes: Zerberus (1-2, magic) is effective vs fliers from Lv 50 (Modified Weapon). The Godhand claim moved from Tobias (D-131).

guide.role: Squad B flier killer: Zerberus at 1-2, Physic and Restore as backup heals
guide.summary: She shoots fliers from 2 tiles with [[item:Zerberus]] (magic damage), then Strike and Heal lets her Physic an ally the same turn. From Lv 50 Modified Weapon makes Zerberus effective vs fliers: ride with squad B on every flier gate.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Zerberus on the flier, Strike and Heal into Physic or Restore. Melee: Wooden Gauntlets +9 for Avo +15. Enemy phase: end 2 tiles behind the Strike line; Res 30 growth means mages hurt.
keys: Refine Zerberus to +2 in Sec 2 Free Time; +3 (Mt 20, Hit 80) is her Soulstone pick.
Reach Lv 50 by Sec 4: Modified Weapon makes Zerberus effective vs fliers.
Arena Warrior S-push seat from Sec 2: Gauntlet S for [[class:The Godhand]].
Sec 4: take the Emperor's Sash (Disciple's Chambers); exam only at 100%.
After each shot, Strike and Heal: Physic squad B from range.
watch: Zerberus: Dur 5, Compressed Laser costs 2. Refines restore it; Shenlo's miasma drains it.
Gauntlet rank: Zerberus needs A; join rank ?. Below A, Iron Gauntlets +4 carry her.
Weight: Zerberus Wt ? or Iron Gauntlets +4 3 (Channels 1 from S5) + Gale Ring 2. Drop the ring first if a staff must go on.
Res: 30 growth. Godhand Res +5 flat and Divine Adornment (Res +10) close it.
Physic rank ?: C (site) vs A+ (sheet). Heal works from D.

decisions.pick: War Monk on join, The Godhand from Sec 4 (Emperor's Sash)
decisions.why: Gauntlet and White boons, and she joins a War Monk Lv 40: only Gauntlet S is left. The Godhand adds Res +5, Spd +5, Brawl Avo +10 and triples Physic uses. Tobias moves to The Eternal (D-131).
decisions.else: Stay War Monk if the exam isn't 100%

decisions.pick: Zerberus +3 main, Wooden Gauntlets +9 for melee
decisions.why: Zerberus hits at 1-2 with magic damage and gets effective vs fliers at Lv 50 (+ at Lv 60). Yun Shou adds Hit +10. Wooden +9 adds Avo +15 and Spd +5 at Wt 1 when she must stand adjacent.
Spd +3 at Wt 2 keeps her doubling fliers. Sofia and Orchel carry the heals; her Physic is backup, so Healing Staff +10 HP is the swap only on heal-heavy maps.
